integrity: The all-parameter statement has a self-contained combinatorial proof; 187 exact-integer checks supplement but do not replace it. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved for affine polygonal prisms with genuine convex n-gonal bases, not arbitrary combinatorial prisms. Historical priority is provisional; complete comparison with the main 2026 paper was inaccessible. General homological identification is prior work.
title: Exact antipodal defect of every convex polygonal prism
